data.lead: Your message has reached the KATIC team.

steps.title: What happens next
steps.text: A member of our team reviews your enquiry and calls or emails you to arrange a first conversation.

steps.title: Response time
steps.text: We reply within one business day (Mon–Sat, 9:30 AM–6:30 PM IST).

steps.title: Talk sooner
steps.text: Prefer to chat now? Continue the conversation with us on WhatsApp.

fallback.message: We couldn’t reach our server just now, so your enquiry may not have reached us. To be sure we get it today, send it by WhatsApp or email using the buttons below, or copy your details.

seo.title: Thank You | Katic Designs
seo.description: Thank you for your enquiry. A member of the Katic Designs team will be in touch within one business day.
